## The problem

What's hard or impossible right now? Lead with the use case, not the
proposed solution.

## What you'd like to see

The shortest description of the change that would solve the above.

## Alternatives you've considered

Optional. If you've thought through workarounds or other designs, list them
here so we don't redo that work.

## Anything else

Context, screenshots, links to similar features in other tools.
